strings.b-00-meta.title: Electric Current ke Magnetic Effects
strings.b-00-meta.objectives.0: Is lesson ke baad aap explain kar sakte hain ki electric current kaise magnetic field produce karta hai aur compass needle kaise dikhati hai.
strings.b-00-meta.objectives.1: Is lesson ke baad aap magnetic field lines describe kar sakte hain aur straight current-carrying conductor ke liye right-hand thumb rule use kar sakte hain.
strings.b-00-meta.objectives.2: Is lesson ke baad aap circular loop, solenoid aur electromagnet ke fields explain kar sakte hain.
strings.b-00-meta.objectives.3: Is lesson ke baad aap current-carrying conductor par force ke liye Fleming's left-hand rule use kar sakte hain aur domestic circuit ke safety parts explain kar sakte hain.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.0.definition: Magnet ke aas-paas ka region jahan uska force detect kiya ja sakta hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.1.definition: Ek line jo dikhati hai ki ek hypothetical free north pole kis path par move karega; ye magnetic field ko represent karti hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.2.definition: Straight current-carrying wire ke around field ki direction ke liye ek rule: thumb current ke along, curled fingers field lines ke along.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.3.definition: Current-carrying conductor par force ke liye ek rule: forefinger field ke along, middle finger current ke along, thumb force ke along.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.4.definition: Ek cylindrical coil jisme wire ke many turns hote hain; iska field bar magnet jaisa hota hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.5.definition: Ek soft iron core jiske around insulated copper wire ki coil wrapped hoti hai, jo current flow hone par magnetic ho jata hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.6.definition: Red-insulated domestic supply wire, jise positive kaha jata hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.7.definition: Black-insulated domestic supply wire, jise negative kaha jata hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.8.definition: Green-insulated safety wire jo earth mein deep metal plate se connected hoti hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.9.definition: Ek safety device jo current bahut zyada hone par melt ho jata hai aur circuit break kar deta hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.10.definition: Live aur neutral wires ke beech direct contact jo current ko abruptly increase kar deta hai.
strings.b-00-meta.glossary.11.definition: Magnetic Resonance Imaging, ek technique jo diagnosis ke liye images banane ke liye body ke magnetic field ko use karti hai.
strings.b-01.paragraphs.0: Ek chhota compass ek seedhi copper wire ke paas rakho. Current flow hone se pehle, needle ek hi direction mein rest karti hai. Jab aap wire se current pass karte hain, toh needle deflect hoti hai. Yeh simple observation is chapter ka darwaza hai.
strings.b-01.paragraphs.1: Yeh deflection ka matlab hai ki copper wire se guzarne wala electric current ne magnetic effect produce kiya hai. Electricity aur magnetism linked hain. Ek current-carrying wire magnet ki tarah behave karti hai.
strings.b-01.paragraphs.2: 1820 mein Hans Christian Oersted ne accidentally paya ki jab ek metallic wire ke paas se electric current pass hota hai toh compass needle deflect ho jati hai. Isne dikhaya ki electricity aur magnetism related phenomena the.
strings.b-01.paragraphs.3: Oersted ka naam magnetic field strength ki unit ke liye use hota hai, the oersted.
strings.b-02.question: Ek seedhi copper wire ke paas rakhi compass needle deflect hoti hai jab wire se current pass kiya jata hai. Yeh kya dikhata hai?
strings.b-02.options.0: Wire permanent magnet ban gaya hai.
strings.b-02.options.1: Electric current ne magnetic effect paida kiya hai.
strings.b-02.options.2: Compass needle ne apna magnetism kho diya hai.
strings.b-02.explanation: Compass needle ka deflect hona dikhata hai ki copper wire se guzarne wale current ne magnetic effect paida kiya hai.
strings.b-03.paragraphs.0: Compass needle ek chhota bar magnet hota hai. Iska north-seeking end lagbhag north ki taraf point karta hai aur north pole kahlata hai; iska south-seeking end lagbhag south ki taraf point karta hai aur south pole kahlata hai. Like poles repel karte hain, jabki unlike poles attract karte hain.
strings.b-03.paragraphs.1: Iron filings ke paas magnet lao to filings ek pattern mein arrange ho jate hain. Magnet apne aas-paas ke region mein force (bal) exert karta hai. Us region mein magnetic field hota hai.
strings.b-03.paragraphs.2: Jin lines ke along iron filings align hote hain unhe magnetic field lines kehte hain. Kisi point par magnetic field ki direction woh direction hoti hai jisme compass needle ka north pole wahan move karta hai.
strings.b-03.paragraphs.3: Field lines north pole se emerge hoti hain aur south pole par merge hoti hain. Magnet ke andar, yeh south pole se north pole tak run karti hain, isliye field lines closed curves hoti hain.
strings.b-03.paragraphs.4: Field lines ki closeness strength dikhati hai: crowded lines ka matlab stronger field. Koi bhi do field lines cross nahi karti, kyunki crossing par compass needle ko ek hi samay do directions mein point karna padega, jo impossible hai.
strings.b-04.caption: Bar magnet ke chaaron taraf field lines hoti hain. Ye north pole se nikalti hain aur south pole mein enter karti hain.
strings.b-05.question: Jab compass needle ko bar magnet ke paas laate hain to wo deflected kyun hoti hai?
strings.b-05.options.0: Magnet ka magnetic field compass needle par force lagata hai, kyunki needle khud ek chhota magnet hai.
strings.b-05.options.1: Compass needle electrically charged ho jaati hai.
strings.b-05.options.2: Bar magnet needle ki magnetism hata deta hai.
strings.b-05.options.3: Unke beech ki hawa needle ko push karti hai.
strings.b-05.explanation: Compass needle ek chhota bar magnet hota hai, isliye paas ke magnet ka field us par force lagakar use ghumata hai.
strings.b-06.title: Bar magnet ke around magnetic field lines kaise draw karein
strings.b-06.steps.0.title: Paper aur magnet ko fix karein
strings.b-06.steps.0.detail: White paper ki ek sheet drawing board par fix karein aur centre mein ek bar magnet rakhein. Magnet ki boundary mark karein.
strings.b-06.steps.1.title: North pole ke paas se shuru karein
strings.b-06.steps.1.detail: Magnet ke north pole ke paas ek chhota compass rakhein. Needle ka south pole magnet ke north pole ki taraf point karta hai, aur compass ka north pole magnet ke north pole se away direction mein hota hai.
strings.b-06.steps.2.title: Mark karein aur aage badhein
strings.b-06.steps.2.detail: Needle ke dono ends ki position mark karein. Compass ko nayi position par move karein taaki uska south pole wahi position le le jo pehle uske north pole ne li thi.
strings.b-06.steps.3.title: South pole tak continue karein
strings.b-06.steps.3.detail: Step by step aage badhein jab tak magnet ke south pole tak na pahunch jayein. Paper par marked points ko ek smooth curve se join karein. Yah curve ek field line represent karta hai.
strings.b-06.steps.4.title: Aur lines draw karein
strings.b-06.steps.4.detail: Procedure repeat karein aur jitni lines draw kar sakte hain karein. Aapko magnet ke around magnetic field lines ka pattern milta hai.
strings.b-07.question: Nimnalikhit mein se kaun si magnetic field lines ki property hai?
strings.b-07.options.0: Yeh magnet ke bahar south pole se emerge hoti hain aur north pole par merge hoti hain.
strings.b-07.options.1: Yeh closed curves hoti hain aur ek doosre ko cross nahi karti.
strings.b-07.options.2: Yeh poles par cross karti hain.
strings.b-07.options.3: Yeh sirf magnet ke andar exist karti hain.
strings.b-07.explanation: Field lines north pole se emerge hoti hain aur south pole par merge hoti hain; magnet ke andar yeh south se north ki taraf jaati hain, isliye yeh closed curves banati hain. Koi bhi do field lines cross nahi karti.
strings.b-08.question: Do magnetic field lines ek doosre ko intersect kyun nahi karti hain?
strings.b-08.options.0: Kyunki intersection point par compass needle do directions mein point karegi, jo possible nahi hai.
strings.b-08.options.1: Kyunki magnetic field lines hamesha straight hoti hain.
strings.b-08.options.2: Kyunki field har jagah zero hoti hai.
strings.b-08.options.3: Kyunki iron filings cross nahi kar sakti hain.
strings.b-08.explanation: Crossing par field ke ek hi point par do directions hote, isliye compass needle ko ek hi samay par do directions mein point karna padta.
strings.b-09.question: Magnetic field produce karne ke kaun se do methods hain?
strings.b-09.options.0: Permanent magnet se aur electric current se.
strings.b-09.options.1: Wire ko heat karke aur magnet ko cool karke.
strings.b-09.options.2: Fuse se aur earth wire se.
strings.b-09.options.3: Neutral wire se aur live wire se.
strings.b-09.explanation: Magnet ke around magnetic field hota hai, aur current-carrying conductor bhi magnetic field produce karta hai.
strings.b-10.paragraphs.0: Ek lambi seedhi copper wire se current pass karo. Jis cardboard se wire guzarti hai us par iron filings chhidko. Ye filings wire ke chaaron taraf concentric circles banati hain. Ye circles magnetic field lines hain.
strings.b-10.paragraphs.1: Agar tum current reverse karte ho, to field lines ki direction reverse ho jaati hai. Agar tum current badhate ho, to compass ka deflection badh jaata hai, isliye field stronger hota hai. Agar tum compass ko wire se door le jaate ho, to deflection kam ho jaata hai, isliye field weaker hota hai.
strings.b-10.paragraphs.2: Ek seedhi current-carrying wire ke chaaron taraf field lines wire par kendrit concentric circles hoti hain.
strings.b-11.question: Nimn mein se kaun sa long straight wire ke paas magnetic field ko sahi describe karta hai?
strings.b-11.options.0: Field wire ke perpendicular straight lines se banta hai.
strings.b-11.options.1: Field wire ke parallel straight lines se banta hai.
strings.b-11.options.2: Field wire se originate hone wali radial lines se banta hai.
strings.b-11.options.3: Field wire par centred concentric circles se banta hai.
strings.b-11.explanation: Ek straight current-carrying wire ke aas-paas iron filings wire par centred concentric circles mein arrange ho jaati hain.
strings.b-12.title: Right-hand thumb rule ka use karna
strings.b-12.steps.0.title: Conductor ko pakdo
strings.b-12.steps.0.detail: Kalpana karo ki tum current-carrying straight conductor ko apne right hand mein pakde hue ho.
strings.b-12.steps.1.title: Thumb ko point karo
strings.b-12.steps.1.detail: Apne thumb ko current ki direction mein point karo.
strings.b-12.steps.2.title: Fingers ko curl karo
strings.b-12.steps.2.detail: Tumhari fingers conductor ke around magnetic field ki field lines ki direction mein wrap ho jaati hain.
strings.b-12.steps.3.title: Doosra naam yaad rakho
strings.b-12.steps.3.detail: Is rule ko Maxwell's corkscrew rule bhi kehte hain.
strings.b-13.problem: Ek horizontal power line mein current east se west direction mein flow karta hai. Iske theek neeche ek point par aur theek upar ek point par magnetic field ki direction kya hogi?
strings.b-13.steps.0.title: Current direction identify karo
strings.b-13.steps.1.title: Right-hand thumb rule apply karo
strings.b-13.steps.1.detail: Right hand ka thumb current ke along point karo; fingers wire ke around magnetic field ki direction mein curl karte hain.
strings.b-13.steps.2.title: East end se dekho
strings.b-13.steps.2.detail: East end se dekha jaye to wire ke neeche ya upar kisi bhi point par magnetic field wire ke perpendicular plane mein clockwise turn karta hai.
strings.b-13.steps.3.title: West end se dekho
strings.b-13.steps.3.detail: West end se dekha jaye to wahi field anti-clockwise turn karta hai.
strings.b-13.answer: East end se dekhne par wire ke neeche ya upar kisi bhi point par magnetic field clockwise turn karta hai, aur west end se dekhne par anti-clockwise turn karta hai.
strings.b-14.caption: Ek seedhi wire ke around concentric circular magnetic field lines hain, jisme current page se bahar ki taraf aata hai. Arrows field direction dikhate hain.
strings.b-15.question: Agar ek seedhi wire mein current reverse kar diya jaye, to uske around magnetic field lines ke saath kya hota hai?
strings.b-15.options.0: Unki direction reverse ho jati hai.
strings.b-15.options.2: Ve wire ke parallel straight lines ban jati hain.
strings.b-15.options.3: Ve stronger ho jati hain lekin same direction mein rehti hain.
strings.b-15.explanation: Current reverse karne se current dwara produce magnetic field ki direction reverse ho jati hai.
strings.b-16.paragraphs.0: Straight wire ko bend karke circular loop bana do. Loop ke har point par field lines wire ke around circles hoti hain. Jaise-jaise aap wire se door jaate hain, ye circles bade hote jaate hain. Loop ke centre par, in bade circles ke arcs straight lines jaise dikhte hain. Wire ka har section loop ke andar apna field same direction mein add karta hai.
strings.b-16.paragraphs.1: Agar coil mein n turns hain, to field single turn ke field se n times bada hota hai, kyunki har turn current ko same direction mein carry karta hai aur fields add up ho jaate hain.
strings.b-17.question: Ek circular wire loop table ke plane mein rakha hai. Jab upar se dekha jaye to loop mein current clockwise hai. Right-hand rule ka use karke, loop ke andar magnetic field ki direction kya hai?
strings.b-17.options.2: Table ke along north ki taraf.
strings.b-17.options.3: Loop ke andar field zero hai.
strings.b-17.explanation: Right hand ki fingers ko current ki clockwise direction mein curl karo; thumb table ke andar ki taraf point karega. Loop ke bahar field lines opposite direction mein wapas aati hain.
strings.b-18.paragraphs.0: Solenoid ek coil hai jisme cylinder ke shape mein wound kai circular turns hote hain. Iski field lines bar magnet ki field lines jaisi hoti hain. Solenoid ke andar field lines straight hoti hain aur field uniform hota hai. Ek end north pole ki tarah kaam karta hai aur doosra south pole ki tarah.
strings.b-18.paragraphs.1: Electromagnet ek soft iron core se banta hai jiske around insulated copper wire ki coil wrapped hoti hai. Current-carrying solenoid andar rakhi steel rod ko magnetise kar sakta hai.
strings.b-19.question: Ek lambi straight solenoid jisme current flow ho raha hai, uske andar magnetic field:
strings.b-19.options.1: uske end ki taraf jaane par ghatta hai.
strings.b-19.options.2: uske end ki taraf jaane par badhta hai.
strings.b-19.options.3: har point par same hota hai.
strings.b-19.explanation: Ek lambi solenoid jisme current flow ho raha hai, uske andar field lines straight hoti hain aur field uniform hota hai, isliye andar har point par field same hota hai.
strings.b-20.question: Kisi diye gaye region mein magnetic field uniform hai. Yeh field lines dwara kaise represent kiya jata hai?
strings.b-20.options.0: Barabar doori par parallel seedhi lines dwara.
strings.b-20.options.2: Ek point se nikalti radial lines dwara.
strings.b-20.options.3: Ek dusre ko cross karne wali lines dwara.
strings.b-20.explanation: Ek uniform field ki har jagah same strength aur direction hoti hai, isliye iski field lines parallel aur barabar doori wali seedhi lines hoti hain.
strings.b-21.paragraphs.0: Magnetic field mein rakha hua current-carrying conductor ek force (bal) experience karta hai. Ek strong horse-shoe magnet ke poles ke beech ek chhoti aluminium rod ko horizontally suspend karo aur usmein current pass karo. Rod displace ho jati hai. Current reverse karo to displacement (visthapan) reverse ho jata hai. Magnetic field reverse karo to force phir se reverse ho jata hai.
strings.b-21.paragraphs.1: Force sabse zyada hota hai jab current magnetic field ke right angles par ho. Current-carrying conductors aur magnetic fields ka use karne wale devices mein electric motors, electric generators, loudspeakers, microphones aur measuring instruments shamil hain.
strings.b-22.title: Fleming's left-hand rule ka upyog
strings.b-22.steps.0.title: Ungliyon ko stretch karein
strings.b-22.steps.0.detail: Apni left hand ke thumb, forefinger aur middle finger ko stretch karein taaki ve ek dusre ke perpendicular hon.
strings.b-22.steps.1.title: First finger ko point karein
strings.b-22.steps.1.detail: First finger ko magnetic field ki direction mein point karein.
strings.b-22.steps.2.title: Second finger ko point karein
strings.b-22.steps.2.detail: Second finger ko current ki direction mein point karein.
strings.b-22.steps.3.title: Thumb ki direction dekhein
strings.b-22.steps.3.detail: Thumb phir motion (gati) ya conductor par lagne wale force (bal) ki direction mein point karta hai.
strings.b-23.problem: Activity 12.7 mein, ek chhoti aluminium rod AB ko stand se horizontally latkaya gaya hai. Ek strong horse-shoe magnet aise rakha gaya hai ki uska north pole rod ke vertically neeche aur south pole vertically upar ho. Rod mein current end B se end A tak pass kiya jata hai, aur rod left ki taraf displaced ho jati hai. Explain kijiye ki rod kyon displaced hoti hai, aur bataiye ki agar rod mein current ki direction reverse kar di jaye to kya observe hoga.
strings.b-23.steps.0.title: Magnetic field (chumbakiya kshetra) ki direction note kijiye
strings.b-23.steps.0.detail: Magnet ka north pole rod ke vertically neeche hai aur south pole vertically upar hai, isliye poles ke beech magnetic field upwards directed hai.
strings.b-23.steps.1.title: Current ki direction note kijiye
strings.b-23.steps.1.detail: Current rod mein end B se end A tak pass kiya jata hai.
strings.b-23.steps.2.title: Force rule apply kijiye
strings.b-23.steps.2.detail: Magnetic field mein rakha current-carrying conductor force (bal) experience karta hai. Yeh force current ki direction aur magnetic field ki direction dono ke perpendicular hota hai, isliye hum iski direction nikalne ke liye Fleming's left-hand rule use karte hain.
strings.b-23.steps.3.title: Fleming's left-hand rule se direction read kijiye
strings.b-23.steps.3.detail: First finger ko magnetic field ke along (upwards) point kijiye aur second finger ko current ke along (B se A) point kijiye. Thumb phir rod par force ki direction deta hai, isi wajah se rod left ki taraf displaced hoti hai.
strings.b-23.steps.4.title: Current reverse kijiye
strings.b-23.steps.4.detail: Conductor mein current ki direction reverse karne par force ki direction reverse ho jati hai. Isliye displacement ab right ki taraf hota hai. (Force sabse zyada hota hai jab current magnetic field ke right angles par ho, jaise yahan hai.)
strings.b-23.answer: Rod left ki taraf displaced hoti hai kyunki current-carrying rod magnetic field mein force experience karti hai, jiski direction Fleming's left-hand rule se milti hai. Current reverse karne par force ki direction reverse ho jati hai, isliye rod ab right ki taraf displaced hoti hai.
strings.b-24.question: Activity 12.7 mein, ek chhoti aluminium rod AB ko ek strong horse-shoe magnet ke poles ke beech latkaya gaya hai aur usme se current pass kiya jata hai. Rod displaced ho jati hai. Yeh kya dikhata hai?
strings.b-24.options.0: Magnetic field mein rakha hua current-carrying conductor force (bal) experience karta hai.
strings.b-24.options.1: Aluminium rod permanent magnet ban gayi hai.
strings.b-24.options.2: Horse-shoe magnet ne apna magnetism kho diya hai.
strings.b-24.options.3: Rod mein current ruk gaya hai.
strings.b-24.explanation: Rod ka displacement (visthapan) yeh darshata hai ki current-carrying aluminium rod par force lagta hai jab use magnetic field mein rakha jata hai.
strings.b-25.question: Activity 12.7 mein, rod AB ke through current ki direction reverse kar di jati hai. Kya observe hota hai?
strings.b-25.options.0: Rod ab opposite direction mein displace ho jati hai.
strings.b-25.options.1: Rod pehle ki tarah same direction mein displace hoti hai.
strings.b-25.options.2: Rod bilkul bhi displace nahi hoti.
strings.b-25.options.3: Rod magnet ban jati hai aur sthir rehti hai.
strings.b-25.explanation: Force (bal) ki direction reverse ho jati hai jab conductor ke through current ki direction reverse hoti hai. Magnetic field ki direction ko poles interchange karke change karne se bhi force reverse ho jata hai.
strings.b-26.question: Ek positively-charged particle (alpha-particle) jab west ki taraf project kiya jata hai, to magnetic field usse north ki taraf deflect karta hai. Magnetic field ki direction kya hai?
strings.b-26.explanation: Fleming's left-hand rule use karein. Current west ki taraf hai aur force (bal) north ki taraf hai; isliye magnetic field upward hona chahiye.
strings.b-27.question: Jab ek current-carrying conductor ko magnetic field mein rakha jata hai, to us par lagne wala force (bal) kab sabse zyada hota hai?
strings.b-27.options.0: Jab current magnetic field ke parallel hota hai.
strings.b-27.options.1: Jab current magnetic field ke right angles par hota hai.
strings.b-27.options.3: Jab conductor field ke bahar hota hai.
strings.b-27.explanation: Rod ka displacement (visthapan) sabse zyada hota hai jab current ki direction magnetic field ki direction ke right angles par hoti hai.
strings.b-28.question: Ek electron beam horizontally chamber ki back wall se front wall ki taraf move karti hai. Yeh ek strong magnetic field ke karan aapke right side ki taraf deflect hoti hai. Magnetic field ki direction kya hai?
strings.b-28.explanation: Electron current electron motion ke opposite hota hai. Fleming's left-hand rule ka use karte hue, force right side ki taraf hone se magnetic field downward milta hai.
strings.b-29.question: Kaunsa rule straight current-carrying conductor ke aas-paas magnetic field ki direction deta hai, aur kaunsa rule magnetic field mein current-carrying conductor par force ki direction deta hai?
strings.b-29.options.0: Fleming's left-hand rule; right-hand thumb rule
strings.b-29.options.1: Right-hand thumb rule; Fleming's left-hand rule
strings.b-29.options.2: Right-hand thumb rule; right-hand thumb rule
strings.b-29.options.3: Fleming's left-hand rule; Fleming's left-hand rule
strings.b-29.explanation: Right-hand thumb rule straight conductor ke aas-paas field ki direction deta hai, aur Fleming's left-hand rule current-carrying conductor par force ki direction deta hai. Chapter rotation se induced current ke liye koi rule nahi batata; yeh sirf electric generator ko ek device ke roop mein naam deta hai.
strings.b-30.paragraphs.0: Gharo mein electric power mains ke through aati hai, chahe overhead poles se ho ya underground cables se. Live wire par aksar red insulation hoti hai aur ye positive hota hai. Neutral wire par black insulation hoti hai aur ye negative hota hai. Hamare desh mein inke beech potential difference 220 V hai. Supply AC hai, 220 V par, frequency 50 Hz ke saath.
strings.b-30.paragraphs.1: Meter-board par wires electricity meter aur main fuse se guzarti hain. Main switch ke through ye line wires se connect hoti hain. Aksar do circuits use hote hain: high-power appliances jaise geysers aur air coolers ke liye 15 A circuit, aur bulbs aur fans ke liye 5 A circuit.
strings.b-30.paragraphs.2: Earth wire par green insulation hoti hai aur ye zameen ke andar gehri metal plate se connected hoti hai. Ye metallic bodies wale appliances ke liye safety measure hai. Ye low-resistance path deta hai taaki metallic body mein current ka koi leakage user ko severe shock na de.
strings.b-30.paragraphs.3: Appliances live aur neutral ke across parallel mein connected hote hain taaki har ek ko same potential difference mile. Har appliance ka apna switch hota hai. Fuse overloading se damage rokta hai. Fuse mein Joule heating use melt karti hai aur circuit break karti hai.
strings.b-30.paragraphs.4: Short-circuiting tab hota hai jab live aur neutral wires seedhe touch karti hain; current abruptly badh jata hai. Overloading supply voltage mein accidental hike se ya ek socket se bahut zyada appliances connect karne se bhi ho sakti hai.
strings.b-31.question: Do safety measures ke naam bataiye jo electric circuits aur appliances mein commonly use hote hain.
strings.b-31.explanation: Fuse overloading se protection deta hai kyunki overload hone par ye melt ho jata hai, aur earth wire leakage current ke liye safety path provide karta hai.
strings.b-32.question: Ek electric fuse domestic circuit ko kaise protect karta hai?
strings.b-32.options.0: Fuse mein Joule heating hoti hai jisse woh melt ho jata hai aur electric circuit toot jata hai.
strings.b-32.options.1: Fuse extra current ko store karta hai aur baad mein supply karta hai.
strings.b-32.options.2: Fuse supply voltage ko badha deta hai.
strings.b-32.options.3: Fuse live wire ko earth wire se connect karta hai.
strings.b-32.explanation: Fuse overloading ke karan appliances aur circuit ko hone wale damage se bachata hai, kyunki yeh had se zyada high electric current ka flow rok deta hai; fuse mein Joule heating hoti hai jisse woh melt ho jata hai aur circuit break ho jata hai.
strings.b-33.question: Domestic electric circuits ke overloading se bachne ke liye kya precaution lena chahiye?
strings.b-33.options.0: Ek hi socket mein bahut saare appliances connect karna.
strings.b-33.options.1: Ek hi socket mein bahut saare appliances connect karne se bachna aur proper rating ka fuse use karna.
strings.b-33.options.2: Earth wire ko live wire se replace karna.
strings.b-33.options.3: Bulbs ke liye sirf 15 A circuits use karna.
strings.b-33.explanation: Overloading tab ho sakti hai jab ek hi socket mein bahut saare appliances connect kiye jaate hain; agar current bahut zyada ho jaye to fuse circuit ko protect karta hai.
strings.b-34.question: Short circuit ke samay, circuit mein current
strings.b-34.explanation: Jab live aur neutral wires directly touch karte hain, to circuit mein current achanak se badh jata hai.
strings.b-35.question: Electric short circuit kab hota hai?
strings.b-35.options.0: Jab live wire aur neutral wire direct contact mein aate hain.
strings.b-35.options.2: Jab earth wire ko metal plate se connect kiya jata hai.
strings.b-35.options.3: Jab main switch off hota hai.
strings.b-35.explanation: Live aur neutral wires ke beech direct contact short-circuiting hai; yeh tab ho sakta hai jab insulation damaged ho ya kisi appliance mein fault ho.
strings.b-36.question: Earth wire ka function kya hai, aur metallic appliances ko earth karna kyun zaroori hai?
strings.b-36.options.0: Yeh normal current carry karta hai aur supply voltage ko badha deta hai.
strings.b-36.options.1: Yeh leakage current ke liye low-resistance path provide karta hai taaki user ko severe shock na lage.
strings.b-36.options.2: Current bahut zyada hone par yeh melt ho jata hai.
strings.b-36.options.3: Yeh appliance ko live bana deta hai.
strings.b-36.explanation: Metallic body earth wire se connected hoti hai. Agar current body mein leak hota hai, to earth wire uska potential earth ke potential ke barabar rakhta hai aur user ko protect karta hai.
strings.b-37.question: Kaun sa statement true hai?
strings.b-37.options.0: Current carry karne wali ek long circular coil ke centre par field parallel straight lines ke roop mein hoga.
strings.b-37.options.1: Green insulation wala wire aam taur par electric supply ka live wire hota hai.
strings.b-37.options.3: Koi bhi statement true nahi hai.
strings.b-37.explanation: Current-carrying circular coil ke centre par field lines parallel straight lines dikhti hain. Green-insulated wire earth wire hota hai, live wire nahi.

lesson.title: Electric Current ke Magnetic Effects
objectives: Is lesson ke baad aap explain kar sakte hain ki electric current kaise magnetic field produce karta hai aur compass needle kaise dikhati hai.
Is lesson ke baad aap magnetic field lines describe kar sakte hain aur straight current-carrying conductor ke liye right-hand thumb rule use kar sakte hain.
Is lesson ke baad aap circular loop, solenoid aur electromagnet ke fields explain kar sakte hain.
Is lesson ke baad aap current-carrying conductor par force ke liye Fleming's left-hand rule use kar sakte hain aur domestic circuit ke safety parts explain kar sakte hain.

sections.title: Ek current magnet ki tarah act kar sakta hai
paragraphs: Ek chhoti compass ko straight copper wire ke paas rakhiye. Current flow hone se pehle, needle ek direction mein rest karti hai. Jab aap wire se current pass karte hain, needle deflect hoti hai. Yah simple observation is chapter ka darwaza hai.
Deflection ka matlab hai ki copper wire se electric current ne magnetic effect produce kiya hai. Electricity aur magnetism linked hain. Current-carrying wire magnet ki tarah behave karti hai.

1820 mein Hans Christian Oersted ne accidentally paya ki jab ek metallic wire se electric current pass hota hai jo paas rakhi hoti hai, to compass needle deflect hoti hai. Isne dikhaya ki electricity aur magnetism related phenomena the.
Oersted ka naam magnetic field strength ke unit ke liye use hota hai, oersted. Is chapter mein aap magnetic fields aur electromagnets study karenge, jo current ke magnetic effect ko use karte hain.

sections.title: Magnetic field aur field lines
paragraphs: Compass needle ek chhota bar magnet hai. Iska north-seeking end approximately north ki taraf point karta hai aur north pole kahlata hai; iska south-seeking end approximately south ki taraf point karta hai aur south pole kahlata hai. Like poles repel karte hain, jabki unlike poles attract karte hain.
Ek magnet ko iron filings ke paas laiye aur filings ek pattern mein arrange ho jati hain. Magnet apne aas-paas ke region mein force (bal) lagata hai. Us region mein magnetic field hota hai.

Jin lines ke along iron filings align hoti hain wo magnetic field lines hain. Aap inhe compass se draw kar sakte hain: compass ko north pole ke paas rakhiye, needle direction mark kijiye, compass ko move kijiye taaki uska south pole purani north-pole position le le, aur step by step south pole tak continue kijiye; points ko smoothly join kijiye.

Kisi point par magnetic field ki direction wo direction hai jisme compass needle ka north pole wahan move karta hai. Field lines north pole se emerge hoti hain aur south pole par merge hoti hain. Magnet ke andar, ye south pole se north pole tak jaati hain, isliye field lines closed curves hoti hain.

Field lines ki closeness strength dikhati hai: crowded lines ka matlab stronger field. Koi bhi do field lines cross nahi karti, kyunki crossing par compass needle ko ek hi samay mein do directions mein point karna padega, jo impossible hai.
Magnetic field permanent magnet se ya electric current se produce ho sakta hai.

sections.title: Straight current-carrying wire ke aas-paas magnetic field
paragraphs: Ek lambi straight copper wire se current pass kijiye. Ek cardboard par iron filings sprinkle kijiye jiske through wire pass hoti hai. Filings wire ke aas-paas concentric circles banati hain. Ye circles magnetic field lines hoti hain.

Agar aap current reverse karte hain, field lines ki direction reverse ho jati hai. Agar aap current increase karte hain, compass deflection increase hoti hai, isliye field stronger hota hai. Agar aap compass ko wire se door le jaate hain, deflection decrease hoti hai, isliye field weaker hota hai.

Direction find karne ke liye, right-hand thumb rule use kijiye. Current-carrying straight conductor ko apne right hand mein is tarah pakdiye ki aapka thumb current ke along point kare. Aapki fingers conductor ke around field lines ki direction mein wrap hoti hain. Ise Maxwell's corkscrew rule bhi kehte hain.

Ek horizontal power line jo east se west current carry karti hai, uske liye line ke directly neeche ya upar kisi point par field clockwise ghumti hai jab east end se dekha jaye, aur anti-clockwise jab west end se dekha jaye.

sections.title: Circular loop, solenoid aur electromagnet
paragraphs: Straight wire ko circular loop mein bend kijiye. Loop ke har point par, field lines wire ke around circles hoti hain. Jab aap wire se door jaate hain, ye circles badi ho jati hain. Loop ke centre par, in badi circles ke arcs straight lines ki tarah dikhte hain. Wire ka har section loop ke andar same direction mein apna field add karta hai.
Agar coil mein n turns hain, to field single turn ke field se n times bada hota hai, kyunki har turn same direction mein current carry karta hai aur fields add up ho jaate hain.

Solenoid ek coil hai jisme cylinder ke shape mein many circular turns wound hote hain. Iski field lines bar magnet ki field lines jaisi hoti hain. Solenoid ke andar field lines straight hoti hain aur field uniform hota hai. Ek end north pole ki tarah act karta hai aur doosra south pole ki tarah.
Electromagnet soft iron core se bana hota hai jiske around insulated copper wire ki coil wrapped hoti hai. Ek current-carrying solenoid apne andar rakhi steel rod ko magnetise kar sakta hai.

sections.title: Magnetic field mein current-carrying conductor par force
paragraphs: Magnetic field mein rakha current-carrying conductor force experience karta hai. Ek chhoti aluminium rod ko strong horse-shoe magnet ke poles ke beech horizontally suspend kijiye aur usse current pass kijiye. Rod displace hoti hai. Current reverse kijiye to displacement (visthapan) reverse ho jata hai. Magnetic field reverse kijiye to force phir reverse ho jata hai.

Force sabse zyada hota hai jab current magnetic field ke right angles par hota hai. Us case mein, Fleming's left-hand rule use kijiye: apne left hand ke thumb, forefinger aur middle finger ko mutually perpendicular stretch kijiye. First finger ko magnetic field ke along point kijiye aur second finger ko current ke along; thumb force ya conductor ke motion (gati) ke along point karta hai.

Ek electron jo magnetic field mein right angles par enter karta hai, wo bhi force experience karta hai. Current direction electron ke motion ke opposite li jati hai. Diye gaye case mein, force page ke into directed hai.
Jin devices mein current-carrying conductors aur magnetic fields use hote hain unme electric motors, electric generators, loudspeakers, microphones aur measuring instruments shamil hain.

sections.title: Domestic electric circuits aur safety
paragraphs: Gharon mein, electric power mains se aati hai, ya to overhead poles se ya underground cables se. Live wire par usually red insulation hoti hai aur wo positive hoti hai. Neutral wire par black insulation hoti hai aur wo negative hoti hai. Hamare desh mein inke beech potential difference 220 V hota hai. Supply AC 220 V par 50 Hz frequency ke saath hoti hai.

Meter-board par, wires electricity meter aur main fuse se pass hoti hain. Main switch ke through ye line wires se connect hoti hain. Aksar do circuits use hote hain: high-power appliances jaise geysers aur air coolers ke liye 15 A circuit, aur bulbs aur fans ke liye 5 A circuit.

Earth wire par green insulation hoti hai aur ye earth mein deep metal plate se connected hoti hai. Ye metallic bodies wale appliances ke liye safety measure hai. Ye low-resistance path provide karti hai taaki metallic body mein current ka koi leakage user ko severe shock na de.

Appliances live aur neutral ke across parallel mein connected hote hain taaki har ek ko same potential difference mile. Har appliance ka apna switch hota hai. Fuse overloading ke karan damage rokta hai. Fuse mein Joule heating usse melt karti hai aur circuit break ho jata hai.

Short-circuiting tab hoti hai jab live aur neutral wires directly touch karti hain; current abruptly increase ho jata hai. Overloading supply voltage mein accidental hike se ya ek socket se bahut saare appliances connect karne se bhi ho sakti hai.

sections.title: Medicine mein magnetism
paragraphs: Body mein electric currents, yahan tak ki nerve cells ke along weak ion currents, magnetic fields produce karte hain. Ye fields bahut weak hoti hain, earth ke magnetic field ki about one-billionth. Heart aur brain do main organs hain jahan produce hone wala magnetic field significant hota hai.
Body ke andar ka magnetic field Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) mein use hota hai different body parts ke images obtain karne ke liye. In images ka analysis medical diagnosis mein help karta hai.

glossary.definition: Magnet ke aas-paas ka region jahan uska force detect kiya ja sakta hai.
Ek line jo dikhati hai ki ek hypothetical free north pole kis path par move karega; ye magnetic field ko represent karti hai.
Straight current-carrying wire ke around field ki direction ke liye ek rule: thumb current ke along, curled fingers field lines ke along.
Current-carrying conductor par force ke liye ek rule: forefinger field ke along, middle finger current ke along, thumb force ke along.
Ek cylindrical coil jisme wire ke many turns hote hain; iska field bar magnet jaisa hota hai.
Ek soft iron core jiske around insulated copper wire ki coil wrapped hoti hai, jo current flow hone par magnetic ho jata hai.
Red-insulated domestic supply wire, jise positive kaha jata hai.
Black-insulated domestic supply wire, jise negative kaha jata hai.
Green-insulated safety wire jo earth mein deep metal plate se connected hoti hai.
Ek safety device jo current bahut zyada hone par melt ho jata hai aur circuit break kar deta hai.
Live aur neutral wires ke beech direct contact jo current ko abruptly increase kar deta hai.
Magnetic Resonance Imaging, ek technique jo diagnosis ke liye images banane ke liye body ke magnetic field ko use karti hai.

spec.question: Ek seedhi copper wire ke paas rakhi compass needle deflect hoti hai jab wire se current pass kiya jata hai. Yeh kya dikhata hai?
options: Wire permanent magnet ban gaya hai.
Electric current ne magnetic effect paida kiya hai.
Compass needle ne apna magnetism kho diya hai.
Current ruk gaya hai.
spec.answer: Electric current ne magnetic effect paida kiya hai.
spec.explanation: Compass needle ka deflect hona dikhata hai ki copper wire se guzarne wale current ne magnetic effect paida kiya hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Current-carrying wire ko magnetic effect se link karna.

spec.question: Jab compass needle ko bar magnet ke paas laate hain to wo deflected kyun hoti hai?
options: Magnet ka magnetic field compass needle par force lagata hai, kyunki needle khud ek chhota magnet hai.
Compass needle electrically charged ho jaati hai.
Bar magnet needle ki magnetism hata deta hai.
Unke beech ki hawa needle ko push karti hai.
spec.answer: Magnet ka magnetic field compass needle par force lagata hai, kyunki needle khud ek chhota magnet hai.
spec.explanation: Compass needle ek chhota bar magnet hota hai, isliye paas ke magnet ka field us par force lagakar use ghumata hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Magnet ke magnetic field ka use karke compass needle ke deflection ko explain karna.

spec.title: Bar magnet ke around magnetic field lines kaise draw karein

steps.title: Paper aur magnet ko fix karein
steps.detail: White paper ki ek sheet drawing board par fix karein aur centre mein ek bar magnet rakhein. Magnet ki boundary mark karein.

steps.title: North pole ke paas se shuru karein
steps.detail: Magnet ke north pole ke paas ek chhota compass rakhein. Needle ka south pole magnet ke north pole ki taraf point karta hai, aur compass ka north pole magnet ke north pole se away direction mein hota hai.

steps.title: Mark karein aur aage badhein
steps.detail: Needle ke dono ends ki position mark karein. Compass ko nayi position par move karein taaki uska south pole wahi position le le jo pehle uske north pole ne li thi.

steps.title: South pole tak continue karein
steps.detail: Step by step aage badhein jab tak magnet ke south pole tak na pahunch jayein. Paper par marked points ko ek smooth curve se join karein. Yah curve ek field line represent karta hai.

steps.title: Aur lines draw karein
steps.detail: Procedure repeat karein aur jitni lines draw kar sakte hain karein. Aapko magnet ke around magnetic field lines ka pattern milta hai.

spec.question: Nimnalikhit mein se kaun si magnetic field lines ki property hai?
options: Yeh magnet ke bahar south pole se emerge hoti hain aur north pole par merge hoti hain.
Yeh closed curves hoti hain aur ek doosre ko cross nahi karti.
Yeh poles par cross karti hain.
Yeh sirf magnet ke andar exist karti hain.
spec.answer: Yeh closed curves hoti hain aur ek doosre ko cross nahi karti.
spec.explanation: Field lines north pole se emerge hoti hain aur south pole par merge hoti hain; magnet ke andar yeh south se north ki taraf jaati hain, isliye yeh closed curves banati hain. Koi bhi do field lines cross nahi karti.
spec.expected_understanding: Magnetic field lines ki properties list karna.

spec.question: Do magnetic field lines ek doosre ko intersect kyun nahi karti hain?
options: Kyunki intersection point par compass needle do directions mein point karegi, jo possible nahi hai.
Kyunki magnetic field lines hamesha straight hoti hain.
Kyunki field har jagah zero hoti hai.
Kyunki iron filings cross nahi kar sakti hain.
spec.answer: Kyunki intersection point par compass needle do directions mein point karegi, jo possible nahi hai.
spec.explanation: Crossing par field ke ek hi point par do directions hote, isliye compass needle ko ek hi samay par do directions mein point karna padta.
spec.expected_understanding: Reason batao ki field lines cross kyun nahi kar sakti hain.

spec.question: Magnetic field produce karne ke kaun se do methods hain?
options: Permanent magnet se aur electric current se.
Wire ko heat karke aur magnet ko cool karke.
Fuse se aur earth wire se.
Neutral wire se aur live wire se.
spec.answer: Permanent magnet se aur electric current se.
spec.explanation: Magnet ke around magnetic field hota hai, aur current-carrying conductor bhi magnetic field produce karta hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Magnetic field produce karne ke do tarike batao.

paragraphs: Ek lambi seedhi copper wire se current pass karo. Jis cardboard se wire guzarti hai us par iron filings chhidko. Ye filings wire ke chaaron taraf concentric circles banati hain. Ye circles magnetic field lines hain.

Agar tum current reverse karte ho, to field lines ki direction reverse ho jaati hai. Agar tum current badhate ho, to compass ka deflection badh jaata hai, isliye field stronger hota hai. Agar tum compass ko wire se door le jaate ho, to deflection kam ho jaata hai, isliye field weaker hota hai.
Ek seedhi current-carrying wire ke chaaron taraf field lines wire par kendrit concentric circles hoti hain.

spec.question: Nimn mein se kaun sa long straight wire ke paas magnetic field ko sahi describe karta hai?
options: Field wire ke perpendicular straight lines se banta hai.
Field wire ke parallel straight lines se banta hai.
Field wire se originate hone wali radial lines se banta hai.
Field wire par centred concentric circles se banta hai.
spec.answer: Field wire par centred concentric circles se banta hai.
spec.explanation: Ek straight current-carrying wire ke aas-paas iron filings wire par centred concentric circles mein arrange ho jaati hain.
spec.expected_understanding: Straight current-carrying wire ke aas-paas magnetic field ka shape pehchanna.

spec.title: Right-hand thumb rule ka use karna

steps.title: Conductor ko pakdo
steps.detail: Kalpana karo ki tum current-carrying straight conductor ko apne right hand mein pakde hue ho.

steps.title: Thumb ko point karo
steps.detail: Apne thumb ko current ki direction mein point karo.

steps.title: Fingers ko curl karo
steps.detail: Tumhari fingers conductor ke around magnetic field ki field lines ki direction mein wrap ho jaati hain.

steps.title: Doosra naam yaad rakho
steps.detail: Is rule ko Maxwell's corkscrew rule bhi kehte hain.

spec.problem: Ek horizontal power line mein current east se west direction mein flow karta hai. Iske theek neeche ek point par aur theek upar ek point par magnetic field ki direction kya hogi?

steps.title: Current direction identify karo
steps.detail: Current east-west direction mein hai.

steps.title: Right-hand thumb rule apply karo
steps.detail: Right hand ka thumb current ke along point karo; fingers wire ke around magnetic field ki direction mein curl karte hain.

steps.title: East end se dekho
steps.detail: East end se dekha jaye to wire ke neeche ya upar kisi bhi point par magnetic field wire ke perpendicular plane mein clockwise turn karta hai.

steps.title: West end se dekho
steps.detail: West end se dekha jaye to wahi field anti-clockwise turn karta hai.

spec.answer: East end se dekhne par wire ke neeche ya upar kisi bhi point par magnetic field clockwise turn karta hai, aur west end se dekhne par anti-clockwise turn karta hai.

spec.question: Agar ek seedhi wire mein current reverse kar diya jaye, to uske around magnetic field lines ke saath kya hota hai?
options: Unki direction reverse ho jati hai.
Ve gayab ho jati hain.
Ve wire ke parallel straight lines ban jati hain.
Ve stronger ho jati hain lekin same direction mein rehti hain.
spec.answer: Unki direction reverse ho jati hai.
spec.explanation: Current reverse karne se current dwara produce magnetic field ki direction reverse ho jati hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Current direction ko field direction se connect karna.

paragraphs: Straight wire ko bend karke circular loop bana do. Loop ke har point par field lines wire ke around circles hoti hain. Jaise-jaise aap wire se door jaate hain, ye circles bade hote jaate hain. Loop ke centre par, in bade circles ke arcs straight lines jaise dikhte hain. Wire ka har section loop ke andar apna field same direction mein add karta hai.
Agar coil mein n turns hain, to field single turn ke field se n times bada hota hai, kyunki har turn current ko same direction mein carry karta hai aur fields add up ho jaate hain.

spec.question: Ek circular wire loop table ke plane mein rakha hai. Jab upar se dekha jaye to loop mein current clockwise hai. Right-hand rule ka use karke, loop ke andar magnetic field ki direction kya hai?
options: Table ke andar ki taraf.
Table se bahar ki taraf.
Table ke along north ki taraf.
Loop ke andar field zero hai.
spec.answer: Table ke andar ki taraf.
spec.explanation: Right hand ki fingers ko current ki clockwise direction mein curl karo; thumb table ke andar ki taraf point karega. Loop ke bahar field lines opposite direction mein wapas aati hain.
spec.expected_understanding: Circular loop ke liye right-hand rule ka use karna.

paragraphs: Solenoid ek coil hai jisme cylinder ke shape mein wound kai circular turns hote hain. Iski field lines bar magnet ki field lines jaisi hoti hain. Solenoid ke andar field lines straight hoti hain aur field uniform hota hai. Ek end north pole ki tarah kaam karta hai aur doosra south pole ki tarah.

spec.question: Ek lambi straight solenoid jisme current flow ho raha hai, uske andar magnetic field:
options: zero hota hai.
uske end ki taraf jaane par ghatta hai.
uske end ki taraf jaane par badhta hai.
har point par same hota hai.
spec.answer: har point par same hota hai.
spec.explanation: Ek lambi solenoid jisme current flow ho raha hai, uske andar field lines straight hoti hain aur field uniform hota hai, isliye andar har point par field same hota hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Jaanen ki lambi solenoid ke andar field uniform hota hai.

spec.question: Kisi diye gaye region mein magnetic field uniform hai. Yeh field lines dwara kaise represent kiya jata hai?
options: Barabar doori par parallel seedhi lines dwara.
Concentric circles dwara.
Ek point se nikalti radial lines dwara.
Ek dusre ko cross karne wali lines dwara.
spec.answer: Barabar doori par parallel seedhi lines dwara.
spec.explanation: Ek uniform field ki har jagah same strength aur direction hoti hai, isliye iski field lines parallel aur barabar doori wali seedhi lines hoti hain.
spec.expected_understanding: Uniform magnetic field ko field lines dwara represent karna.

paragraphs: Magnetic field mein rakha hua current-carrying conductor ek force (bal) experience karta hai. Ek strong horse-shoe magnet ke poles ke beech ek chhoti aluminium rod ko horizontally suspend karo aur usmein current pass karo. Rod displace ho jati hai. Current reverse karo to displacement (visthapan) reverse ho jata hai. Magnetic field reverse karo to force phir se reverse ho jata hai.

Force sabse zyada hota hai jab current magnetic field ke right angles par ho. Current-carrying conductors aur magnetic fields ka use karne wale devices mein electric motors, electric generators, loudspeakers, microphones aur measuring instruments shamil hain.

steps.title: Ungliyon ko stretch karein
steps.detail: Apni left hand ke thumb, forefinger aur middle finger ko stretch karein taaki ve ek dusre ke perpendicular hon.

steps.title: First finger ko point karein
steps.detail: First finger ko magnetic field ki direction mein point karein.

steps.title: Second finger ko point karein
steps.detail: Second finger ko current ki direction mein point karein.

steps.title: Thumb ki direction dekhein
steps.detail: Thumb phir motion (gati) ya conductor par lagne wale force (bal) ki direction mein point karta hai.

spec.problem: Activity 12.7 mein, ek chhoti aluminium rod AB ko stand se horizontally latkaya gaya hai. Ek strong horse-shoe magnet aise rakha gaya hai ki uska north pole rod ke vertically neeche aur south pole vertically upar ho. Rod mein current end B se end A tak pass kiya jata hai, aur rod left ki taraf displaced ho jati hai. Explain kijiye ki rod kyon displaced hoti hai, aur bataiye ki agar rod mein current ki direction reverse kar di jaye to kya observe hoga.

steps.title: Magnetic field (chumbakiya kshetra) ki direction note kijiye
steps.detail: Magnet ka north pole rod ke vertically neeche hai aur south pole vertically upar hai, isliye poles ke beech magnetic field upwards directed hai.

steps.title: Current ki direction note kijiye
steps.detail: Current rod mein end B se end A tak pass kiya jata hai.

steps.title: Force rule apply kijiye
steps.detail: Magnetic field mein rakha current-carrying conductor force (bal) experience karta hai. Yeh force current ki direction aur magnetic field ki direction dono ke perpendicular hota hai, isliye hum iski direction nikalne ke liye Fleming's left-hand rule use karte hain.

steps.title: Fleming's left-hand rule se direction read kijiye
steps.detail: First finger ko magnetic field ke along (upwards) point kijiye aur second finger ko current ke along (B se A) point kijiye. Thumb phir rod par force ki direction deta hai, isi wajah se rod left ki taraf displaced hoti hai.

steps.title: Current reverse kijiye
steps.detail: Conductor mein current ki direction reverse karne par force ki direction reverse ho jati hai. Isliye displacement ab right ki taraf hota hai. (Force sabse zyada hota hai jab current magnetic field ke right angles par ho, jaise yahan hai.)

spec.answer: Rod left ki taraf displaced hoti hai kyunki current-carrying rod magnetic field mein force experience karti hai, jiski direction Fleming's left-hand rule se milti hai. Current reverse karne par force ki direction reverse ho jati hai, isliye rod ab right ki taraf displaced hoti hai.

spec.question: Activity 12.7 mein, ek chhoti aluminium rod AB ko ek strong horse-shoe magnet ke poles ke beech latkaya gaya hai aur usme se current pass kiya jata hai. Rod displaced ho jati hai. Yeh kya dikhata hai?
options: Magnetic field mein rakha hua current-carrying conductor force (bal) experience karta hai.
Aluminium rod permanent magnet ban gayi hai.
Horse-shoe magnet ne apna magnetism kho diya hai.
Rod mein current ruk gaya hai.
spec.answer: Magnetic field mein rakha hua current-carrying conductor force (bal) experience karta hai.
spec.explanation: Rod ka displacement (visthapan) yeh darshata hai ki current-carrying aluminium rod par force lagta hai jab use magnetic field mein rakha jata hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Activity 12.7 mein rod ke displacement se kya pata chalta hai, yeh batao.

spec.question: Activity 12.7 mein, rod AB ke through current ki direction reverse kar di jati hai. Kya observe hota hai?
options: Rod ab opposite direction mein displace ho jati hai.
Rod pehle ki tarah same direction mein displace hoti hai.
Rod bilkul bhi displace nahi hoti.
Rod magnet ban jati hai aur sthir rehti hai.
spec.answer: Rod ab opposite direction mein displace ho jati hai.
spec.explanation: Force (bal) ki direction reverse ho jati hai jab conductor ke through current ki direction reverse hoti hai. Magnetic field ki direction ko poles interchange karke change karne se bhi force reverse ho jata hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Current-carrying rod par lagne wale force ki direction ko current ki direction aur magnetic field ki direction se relate karo.

spec.question: Ek positively-charged particle (alpha-particle) jab west ki taraf project kiya jata hai, to magnetic field usse north ki taraf deflect karta hai. Magnetic field ki direction kya hai?
options: South ki taraf
East ki taraf
Neeche ki taraf
Upar ki taraf
spec.answer: Upar ki taraf
spec.explanation: Fleming's left-hand rule use karein. Current west ki taraf hai aur force (bal) north ki taraf hai; isliye magnetic field upward hona chahiye.
spec.expected_understanding: Fleming's left-hand rule ko positively charged particle par apply karein.

spec.question: Jab ek current-carrying conductor ko magnetic field mein rakha jata hai, to us par lagne wala force (bal) kab sabse zyada hota hai?
options: Jab current magnetic field ke parallel hota hai.
Jab current magnetic field ke right angles par hota hai.
Jab current zero hota hai.
Jab conductor field ke bahar hota hai.
spec.answer: Jab current magnetic field ke right angles par hota hai.
spec.explanation: Rod ka displacement (visthapan) sabse zyada hota hai jab current ki direction magnetic field ki direction ke right angles par hoti hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Conductor par sabse zyada magnetic force milne ki condition batao.

spec.question: Ek electron beam horizontally chamber ki back wall se front wall ki taraf move karti hai. Yeh ek strong magnetic field ke karan aapke right side ki taraf deflect hoti hai. Magnetic field ki direction kya hai?
options: Upward
Downward
Front wall ki taraf
Back wall ki taraf
spec.answer: Downward
spec.explanation: Electron current electron motion ke opposite hota hai. Fleming's left-hand rule ka use karte hue, force right side ki taraf hone se magnetic field downward milta hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Left-hand rule ka use karein jisme current electron motion ke opposite ho.

spec.question: Kaunsa rule straight current-carrying conductor ke aas-paas magnetic field ki direction deta hai, aur kaunsa rule magnetic field mein current-carrying conductor par force ki direction deta hai?
options: Fleming's left-hand rule; right-hand thumb rule
Right-hand thumb rule; Fleming's left-hand rule
Right-hand thumb rule; right-hand thumb rule
Fleming's left-hand rule; Fleming's left-hand rule
spec.answer: Right-hand thumb rule; Fleming's left-hand rule
spec.explanation: Right-hand thumb rule straight conductor ke aas-paas field ki direction deta hai, aur Fleming's left-hand rule current-carrying conductor par force ki direction deta hai. Chapter rotation se induced current ke liye koi rule nahi batata; yeh sirf electric generator ko ek device ke roop mein naam deta hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Har rule ko uske use se match karo.

paragraphs: Gharo mein electric power mains ke through aati hai, chahe overhead poles se ho ya underground cables se. Live wire par aksar red insulation hoti hai aur ye positive hota hai. Neutral wire par black insulation hoti hai aur ye negative hota hai. Hamare desh mein inke beech potential difference 220 V hai. Supply AC hai, 220 V par, frequency 50 Hz ke saath.

Meter-board par wires electricity meter aur main fuse se guzarti hain. Main switch ke through ye line wires se connect hoti hain. Aksar do circuits use hote hain: high-power appliances jaise geysers aur air coolers ke liye 15 A circuit, aur bulbs aur fans ke liye 5 A circuit.

Earth wire par green insulation hoti hai aur ye zameen ke andar gehri metal plate se connected hoti hai. Ye metallic bodies wale appliances ke liye safety measure hai. Ye low-resistance path deta hai taaki metallic body mein current ka koi leakage user ko severe shock na de.

Appliances live aur neutral ke across parallel mein connected hote hain taaki har ek ko same potential difference mile. Har appliance ka apna switch hota hai. Fuse overloading se damage rokta hai. Fuse mein Joule heating use melt karti hai aur circuit break karti hai.

Short-circuiting tab hota hai jab live aur neutral wires seedhe touch karti hain; current abruptly badh jata hai. Overloading supply voltage mein accidental hike se ya ek socket se bahut zyada appliances connect karne se bhi ho sakti hai.

spec.question: Do safety measures ke naam bataiye jo electric circuits aur appliances mein commonly use hote hain.
options: Fuse aur earth wire
Live wire aur neutral wire
Red insulation aur black insulation
5 A aur 15 A
spec.answer: Fuse aur earth wire
spec.explanation: Fuse overloading se protection deta hai kyunki overload hone par ye melt ho jata hai, aur earth wire leakage current ke liye safety path provide karta hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Ghar ke do safety measures recall karna.

spec.question: Ek electric fuse domestic circuit ko kaise protect karta hai?
options: Fuse mein Joule heating hoti hai jisse woh melt ho jata hai aur electric circuit toot jata hai.
Fuse extra current ko store karta hai aur baad mein supply karta hai.
Fuse supply voltage ko badha deta hai.
Fuse live wire ko earth wire se connect karta hai.
spec.answer: Fuse mein Joule heating hoti hai jisse woh melt ho jata hai aur electric circuit toot jata hai.
spec.explanation: Fuse overloading ke karan appliances aur circuit ko hone wale damage se bachata hai, kyunki yeh had se zyada high electric current ka flow rok deta hai; fuse mein Joule heating hoti hai jisse woh melt ho jata hai aur circuit break ho jata hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Electric fuse ke working ko samjhaiye ki yeh overloading ke against safety device ke roop mein kaise kaam karta hai.

spec.question: Domestic electric circuits ke overloading se bachne ke liye kya precaution lena chahiye?
options: Ek hi socket mein bahut saare appliances connect karna.
Ek hi socket mein bahut saare appliances connect karne se bachna aur proper rating ka fuse use karna.
Earth wire ko live wire se replace karna.
Bulbs ke liye sirf 15 A circuits use karna.
spec.answer: Ek hi socket mein bahut saare appliances connect karne se bachna aur proper rating ka fuse use karna.
spec.explanation: Overloading tab ho sakti hai jab ek hi socket mein bahut saare appliances connect kiye jaate hain; agar current bahut zyada ho jaye to fuse circuit ko protect karta hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Overloading se bachne ke liye ek precaution batao.

spec.question: Short circuit ke samay, circuit mein current
options: kaafi kam ho jata hai.
change nahi hota.
bahut zyada badh jata hai.
lagatar badalta rehta hai.
spec.answer: bahut zyada badh jata hai.
spec.explanation: Jab live aur neutral wires directly touch karte hain, to circuit mein current achanak se badh jata hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Short circuit par current mein hone wale change ko samjhein.

spec.question: Electric short circuit kab hota hai?
options: Jab live wire aur neutral wire direct contact mein aate hain.
Jab fuse pighalta hai.
Jab earth wire ko metal plate se connect kiya jata hai.
Jab main switch off hota hai.
spec.answer: Jab live wire aur neutral wire direct contact mein aate hain.
spec.explanation: Live aur neutral wires ke beech direct contact short-circuiting hai; yeh tab ho sakta hai jab insulation damaged ho ya kisi appliance mein fault ho.
spec.expected_understanding: Short circuit ko define karna.

spec.question: Earth wire ka function kya hai, aur metallic appliances ko earth karna kyun zaroori hai?
options: Yeh normal current carry karta hai aur supply voltage ko badha deta hai.
Yeh leakage current ke liye low-resistance path provide karta hai taaki user ko severe shock na lage.
Current bahut zyada hone par yeh melt ho jata hai.
Yeh appliance ko live bana deta hai.
spec.answer: Yeh leakage current ke liye low-resistance path provide karta hai taaki user ko severe shock na lage.
spec.explanation: Metallic body earth wire se connected hoti hai. Agar current body mein leak hota hai, to earth wire uska potential earth ke potential ke barabar rakhta hai aur user ko protect karta hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Earth wire ka purpose explain karo.

spec.question: Kaun sa statement true hai?
options: Current carry karne wali ek long circular coil ke centre par field parallel straight lines ke roop mein hoga.
Green insulation wala wire aam taur par electric supply ka live wire hota hai.
Dono statements true hain.
Koi bhi statement true nahi hai.
spec.answer: Current carry karne wali ek long circular coil ke centre par field parallel straight lines ke roop mein hoga.
spec.explanation: Current-carrying circular coil ke centre par field lines parallel straight lines dikhti hain. Green-insulated wire earth wire hota hai, live wire nahi.
spec.expected_understanding: Coil fields aur wire colours ke baare mein true-false statements check karna.

paragraphs: Body mein electric currents, yahan tak ki nerve cells ke saath weak ion currents bhi, magnetic fields paida karte hain. Ye fields bahut weak hain, earth ke magnetic field ka lagbhag one-billionth. Heart aur brain do main organs hain jahan produce hone wala magnetic field significant hai.
Body ke andar ka magnetic field Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) mein different body parts ke images obtain karne ke liye use hota hai. In images ka analysis medical diagnosis mein help karta hai.

spec.question: Kaun si technique body ke andar magnetic field ka use karke medical diagnosis ke liye different body parts ki images obtain karti hai?
options: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)
Electric fuse
Solenoid
Oersted unit
spec.answer: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)
spec.explanation: MRI body ke andar magnetic field ka use karke images obtain karta hai; in images ka analysis medical diagnosis mein help karta hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Chapter mein describe magnetic fields ke medical use ko recall karo.
